title: Incursa.Quic Public Resumption-Only Transport API Verification
verification_method: Focused API requirement-home execution, resumption-path loopback checks, and public-surface inspection for the opaque ticket carrier and resumption outcome.
preconditions: The supported public listener/connect loopback path exists.
The internal ticket export and import path can emit a detached resumption snapshot.
The server-side ticket issuance path can be enabled without exposing any public early-data toggle.
The public API surface can be inspected through the analyzer and requirement-home tests.
scope: This artifact covers only the bounded public resumption-only transport API slice: opaque ticket import/export, public resumption outcome, and the minimal server issuance switch. It does not claim public early-data support, 0-RTT admission, or broader transport behavior changes.
expected_result: The trace shows a public ticket carrier that copies caller input, a public outcome enum that reports resumed/rejected/invalid/full-handshake states, a connection API that can export a ticket and accept an imported ticket, a public server issuance switch, and no public early-data toggle.
procedure: Inspect `SPEC-QUIC-API`, `ARC-QUIC-API-0008`, `WI-QUIC-API-0008`, `VER-QUIC-API-0008`, and the current public API docs to confirm the resumption slice is transport-only.
Run `dotnet test tests/Incursa.Quic.Tests/Incursa.Quic.Tests.csproj --no-restore -m:1 --filter "FullyQualifiedName~REQ_QUIC_API_0017"` and preserve the output for the public resumption slice.

Run the relevant public API compatibility filter(s) that cover `REQ-QUIC-API-0001`, `REQ-QUIC-API-0003`, and `REQ-QUIC-API-0005` to confirm the new members are present and the option defaults remain unchanged.
Confirm the new public surface does not add any early-data switch and that exported tickets survive source disposal.
Run `git diff --check` and the repo's usual focused public-surface verification checks before closing the slice.
status_summary: Passed on 2026-07-10 through implementation and targeted requirement-home checks for the public resumption-only transport API slice. The public surface now exposes opaque ticket import/export, the resumption outcome enum/property, and the minimal server issuance switch, while keeping early-data inaccessible.
